errors.evidence: The description states the Y-axis has intervals of 1000, but the labeled major grid lines are at intervals of 5000 (0, 5000, 10000, etc.).

errors.text_span: На графиката са представени три линии.
errors.evidence: The chart shows only two data series (lines), one orange and one blue, not three.

errors.text_span: Тя започва от стойност 18055 през 2000 г.
errors.evidence: The orange line starts at the value 16328 in the year 2000, not 18055. The value 18055 corresponds to the year 2002.

errors.text_span: Приблизителни върхове са наблюдавани през 2011 г. при стойност 24456
errors.evidence: For the orange line, the value in 2011 is 23759. The value 24456 corresponds to the year 2012.
The markers for the blue line are circular, not triangular.
The blue line is not a standard dotted or dashed line ('пунктирана'), but rather consists of solid segments connecting the markers. This is an inaccurate description of the line style.
The blue line ends at the value 31149 in 2018, not 28088. The value 28098 (very close to the reported one) is the end value for the orange line.

errors.text_span: Върхове са наблюдавани през 2011 г. при стойност 25922
errors.evidence: For the blue line, the value in 2011 is 22891. The value 25922 corresponds to the blue line in the year 2014.

errors.text_span: Третата линия е в синьо, с кръгли маркери и плътна линия. Тя започва от стойност 16328 през 2000 г. и се увеличава до 28098 през 2018 г. Приблизителен връх е наблюдаван през 2015 г. при стойност 26777.
errors.evidence: This entire sentence describes a third line that does not exist. It incorrectly combines attributes and values from the two actual lines. For instance, it uses the correct start and end values of the orange line (16328 and 28098) but assigns them to a hallucinated third line.
